citation: Lamon S, et al. 2021. The effect of acute sleep deprivation on skeletal muscle protein synthesis and the hormonal environment. Physiological Reports 9:e14660.
protocol: One night of total sleep deprivation (DEP) vs control night of sleep 22:00-07:00 (CON), standardized meals, plasma cortisol sampled from 08:00 with AUC 10:00-16:00
population: n=13 healthy young adults (7 male, 6 female), age 22 +/- 1 y
note: Cortisol AUC over stated clock times; the cortisol curve is a figure. Insulin and glucose are not printed as values. Paper states all data are mean +/- SD.
